# Nosotros — Bredaz

URL: https://bredaz.com/nosotros.html

1 Quiénes somos

Bredaz es un estudio de software con base en la Ciudad Autónoma de Buenos Aires, Argentina. Diseñamos y desarrollamos aplicaciones propias y software a medida, combinando métodos tradicionales con inteligencia artificial.

Trabajamos sobre una idea simple: software con propósito real, que resuelva problemas cotidianos concretos y no solo demos técnicas.

## 2 Equipo

Bredaz es un equipo de dos personas:

  * **[Juan Martín Cerezo](./juan-martin-cerezo.html)** — Co-fundador y CTO. Desarrollo, producto e integración de inteligencia artificial.
  * **Juan Francisco Ginabreda** — Co-fundador. Producto y operaciones.

Organización en GitHub: [github.com/Bredaz](https://github.com/Bredaz)

## 3 Qué construimos

**EncryptIA** — nuestra aplicación insignia. Enseña métodos de encriptación clásicos, permite cifrar mensajes en grupo y usa inteligencia artificial para identificar qué clave se utilizó en un texto cifrado. Nació en el mundo scout y está disponible de forma gratuita en Google Play, App Store y web.

**Software a medida** — desarrollo de aplicaciones web y móviles, integración de modelos de IA, automatizaciones y herramientas internas para equipos y organizaciones.

## 4 Datos de la empresa

Nombre comercial: **Bredaz**. Domicilio: Ciudad Autónoma de Buenos Aires, Argentina. Correo de contacto: [support@bredaz.com](mailto:support@bredaz.com). Sitio web: [bredaz.com](https://bredaz.com).

  * GitHub: [github.com/Bredaz](https://github.com/Bredaz)
  * Google Play: [EncryptIA](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.bredaz.encryptia)
  * Instagram: [@somosbredaz](https://www.instagram.com/somosbredaz)
  * X: [@somosbredaz](https://x.com/somosbredaz)

## 5 Contacto

Consultas comerciales, propuestas de proyectos o soporte: [support@bredaz.com](mailto:support@bredaz.com?subject=Consulta%20-%20Bredaz). Respondemos dentro de las 48 horas hábiles.

Documentos legales: [Términos y Condiciones de Servicio](./terminos.html) · [Política de Privacidad de EncryptIA](./encryptia/privacy.html).

# About Bredaz — Software studio in Buenos Aires

URL: https://bredaz.com/about.html

1 Who we are

Bredaz is an independent software studio based in Ciudad Autónoma de Buenos Aires, Argentina. We design and build our own products as well as custom software, combining classical engineering methods with applied artificial intelligence.

Our guiding idea is simple: software with a real purpose — tools that solve concrete, everyday problems instead of technical demos.

## 2 Team

Bredaz is a team of two people:

  * **[Juan Martín Cerezo](./juan-martin-cerezo.html)** — Co-founder and CTO. Development, product and AI integration.
  * **Juan Francisco Ginabreda** — Co-founder. Product and operations.

GitHub organization: [github.com/Bredaz](https://github.com/Bredaz)

## 3 What we build

**EncryptIA** (flagship product) — teaches 40+ classical encryption methods, lets groups exchange encrypted messages, and uses AI to identify which cipher and key were used on a given ciphertext. Free on Google Play, the App Store and the web. It was born inside the scout movement.

**Custom software** — web and mobile applications, AI/LLM integration, automations and internal tools for teams and organizations.

## 4 How we work

Small team, direct contact, short iteration cycles. We scope in writing before writing code, prototype early and ship to real users.

Typical engagements: a web or mobile product from scratch, adding AI to an existing workflow, or automating an internal process.

We work in Spanish and English, remotely and in person in Buenos Aires. Pricing is quoted per project — we do not publish public price tiers.

## 5 Company details

Commercial name: **Bredaz**. Location: Ciudad Autónoma de Buenos Aires, Argentina. Contact email: [support@bredaz.com](mailto:support@bredaz.com). Website: [bredaz.com](https://bredaz.com).

  * GitHub: [github.com/Bredaz](https://github.com/Bredaz)
  * Google Play: [EncryptIA](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.bredaz.encryptia)
  * Instagram: [@somosbredaz](https://www.instagram.com/somosbredaz)
  * X: [@somosbredaz](https://x.com/somosbredaz)

## 6 Contact

Business inquiries, project proposals and support: [support@bredaz.com](mailto:support@bredaz.com?subject=Inquiry%20-%20Bredaz). We reply within 48 business hours. Full list of channels on the [Contact page](./contact.html).

Legal documents: [Terms of Service](./terminos.html) · [EncryptIA privacy policy](./encryptia/privacy.html) · [Website privacy policy](./privacy.html).

# EncryptIA by Bredaz

URL: https://bredaz.com/encryptia/

1 Qué es EncryptIA

EncryptIA es una aplicación educativa creada por [Bredaz](../nosotros.html) que enseña cómo funcionan los métodos de encriptación clásicos y permite practicarlos con mensajes reales. Nació en el mundo scout: empezó como una herramienta para que las patrullas pudieran cifrar y descifrar mensajes, y creció hasta convertirse en una plataforma abierta.

## 2 Qué podés hacer

  * **Aprender métodos de encriptación clásicos:** más de 40 cifrados históricos explicados paso a paso.
  * **Cifrar tus textos:** escribí un mensaje, elegí el método y compartilo cifrado con tu grupo.
  * **Detectar la clave con IA:** si te llega un mensaje cifrado y no sabés qué método se usó, la inteligencia artificial lo analiza e identifica la clave más probable.
  * **Practicar:** ejercicios y desafíos para reconocer cifrados a simple vista.

## 3 Descargar

  * **Android:** [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.bredaz.encryptia)
  * **iOS:** App Store (próximamente enlace público)
  * **Web:** [versión web](https://bredaz.com/#encryptia)
  * **Repositorio de documentación:** [github.com/Bredaz/encryptia-app](https://github.com/Bredaz/encryptia-app)

La aplicación es gratuita. No requiere pago ni suscripción.

## 4 Sobre la IA y sus límites

La identificación automática de claves es una herramienta de asistencia educativa: puede equivocarse o devolver resultados parciales. No debe usarse para proteger información sensible ni como único método de verificación criptográfica.

## 6 Identidad del producto

**EncryptIA by Bredaz** es un desarrollo independiente creado por Bredaz, estudio de software con base en la Ciudad Autónoma de Buenos Aires, Argentina, publicado como la aplicación _EncryptIA_ en Google Play (paquete `com.bredaz.encryptia`) y en bredaz.com.

No tiene relación, vínculo ni afiliación con otras empresas, productos, aplicaciones o repositorios que usen un nombre similar en otros países. La fuente oficial de información sobre EncryptIA es [bredaz.com/encryptia](https://bredaz.com/encryptia/).

## 5 Privacidad y contacto

Política de privacidad de la app: [bredaz.com/encryptia/privacy.html](./privacy.html). Consultas: [support@bredaz.com](mailto:support@bredaz.com?subject=Consulta%20-%20EncryptIA).

# Privacy Policy — bredaz.com

URL: https://bredaz.com/privacy.html

1 What this website collects

Nothing. The bredaz.com website has no contact forms, no user accounts, no analytics, no advertising or tracking pixels, and sets no cookies of its own. Email links simply open your mail client.

## 2 Information you send by email

If you write to an @bredaz.com address, we receive your email address and message and keep them for as long as needed to answer and to keep a record of the conversation. Mail is handled by Zoho Mail. We do not sell or share it, except where legally required.

## 3 Hosting and technical logs

The site is served through GitHub Pages (GitHub, Inc.) and Cloudflare (DNS and CDN). Those providers may automatically log IP address, user agent, requested URL and timestamp for security, performance and abuse prevention. We do not receive those logs as personal profiles and do not use them for marketing. Retention follows each provider's own policy.

## 4 Cookies

No cookies are set by our code. The CDN may set strictly necessary security cookies to protect against abuse; the site works with cookies disabled.

## 5 Third-party links and services

  * Related app: [EncryptIA privacy policy](./encryptia/privacy.html) (covers the mobile and web app).
  * Download and profile links point to third parties (Google Play, GitHub, Instagram, X, TikTok) whose own privacy policies apply once you leave our site.

## 6 Children

This website is not directed at children under 13. EncryptIA is educational software for general audiences, including the scout movement.

## 7 Your rights

You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of any personal information you sent us. In Argentina this is covered by Ley 25.326 de Protección de Datos Personales. Write to [support@bredaz.com](mailto:support@bredaz.com?subject=Data%20request%20-%20Bredaz) and we will respond within 10 business days.

## 8 Changes to this policy

We will update this page when practices change, and adjust the date below. The [Terms of Service](./terminos.html) cover use of the site and our products.

## 9 Contact

Questions about this policy or about data protection: [support@bredaz.com](mailto:support@bredaz.com?subject=Privacy%20-%20Bredaz). Other channels are listed on the [Contact page](./contact.html).

# Términos y Condiciones — Bredaz

URL: https://bredaz.com/terminos.html

1 Identificación del prestador

Los presentes Términos y Condiciones regulan el uso de los servicios y productos ofrecidos por **Bredaz** (en adelante, «Bredaz»), con domicilio en la Ciudad Autónoma de Buenos Aires, República Argentina, correo electrónico [support@bredaz.com](mailto:support@bredaz.com).

Este documento aplica a **EncryptIA** (aplicación móvil y versión web) y a los servicios de desarrollo de software a medida contratados con Bredaz.

## 2 Aceptación

El uso de cualquiera de los productos o servicios de Bredaz implica la aceptación plena de estos Términos. Si no está de acuerdo con ellos, no utilice los servicios.

Para la contratación de servicios a medida, estos Términos se complementan con la propuesta comercial y el presupuesto aceptado por el cliente, que prevalecen sobre este documento en caso de conflicto.

## 3 Descripción de los servicios

**EncryptIA:** aplicación educativa y de uso recreativo que permite aprender métodos de encriptación clásicos, cifrar y descifrar mensajes propios y solicitar la identificación de la clave utilizada mediante modelos de inteligencia artificial. Se ofrece de forma gratuita y sin garantía de disponibilidad ininterrumpida.

**Desarrollo a medida:** diseño, desarrollo y mantenimiento de software, integración de modelos de IA y automatizaciones, en los plazos y condiciones acordados por escrito con cada cliente.

## 4 Uso permitido

El usuario se compromete a utilizar los servicios conforme a la ley, la moral y el orden público, y en particular a no: (a) utilizar EncryptIA para cifrar, distribuir o facilitar contenido ilícito; (b) intentar vulnerar la seguridad de los sistemas de Bredaz; (c) realizar ingeniería inversa, revender o sublicenciar los servicios sin autorización escrita; (d) utilizar los servicios para acosar, amenazar o perjudicar a terceros.

Bredaz puede suspender o limitar el acceso ante un uso contrario a estas reglas.

## 5 Contenido generado con inteligencia artificial

Las funciones de IA de EncryptIA (identificación de claves y análisis de textos cifrados) son herramientas de asistencia con fines educativos y recreativos. Pueden producir resultados **incorrectos o parciales**.

El usuario no debe utilizar estas funciones para proteger información sensible, ni como único método de verificación criptográfica. Bredaz no garantiza la exactitud del resultado y no asume responsabilidad por decisiones tomadas en base a él.

## 6 Propiedad intelectual

El nombre Bredaz, el nombre EncryptIA, sus logotipos, el código fuente, los diseños y los contenidos del sitio son propiedad de Bredaz o se utilizan con autorización. No se concede ninguna licencia sobre ellos más allá del uso normal de los servicios.

El contenido que el usuario ingresa en la aplicación (mensajes, textos) sigue siendo del usuario. El usuario es responsable de contar con los derechos necesarios sobre lo que ingresa.

## 7 Privacidad y datos personales

El tratamiento de datos personales se rige por la [Política de Privacidad de EncryptIA](./encryptia/privacy.html) y por la Ley 25.326 de Protección de Datos Personales de la República Argentina. Bredaz no vende datos personales a terceros.

Para ejercer los derechos de acceso, rectificación, actualización o supresión de datos, el usuario puede escribir a [support@bredaz.com](mailto:support@bredaz.com).

## 8 Menores de edad

EncryptIA es apta para todo público, pero su contratación de servicios y el uso de funciones con cuentas de usuario requieren la intervención de un adulto responsable cuando el usuario sea menor de edad, conforme a la legislación argentina.

## 9 Disponibilidad, cambios y precios

Bredaz puede modificar, suspender o discontinuar funciones de sus productos, y puede actualizar estos Términos. Las modificaciones se publican en esta página con su fecha de vigencia. Los precios de los servicios a medida son los del presupuesto aceptado por el cliente.

## 10 Limitación de responsabilidad

En la máxima medida permitida por la ley, Bredaz no responde por daños indirectos, lucro cesante, pérdida de datos o daños derivados del uso o de la imposibilidad de uso de los servicios, ni por interrupciones causadas por terceros, proveedores de infraestructura o fuerza mayor.

Nada en estos Términos limita los derechos que la Ley 24.240 de Defensa del Consumidor reconoce a los consumidores.

## 11 Ley aplicable y jurisdicción

Estos Términos se rigen por las leyes de la República Argentina. Para los reclamos de consumidores se aplican los tribunales del domicilio del consumidor; para las controversias entre empresas, los Tribunales Ordinarios en lo Comercial de la Ciudad Autónoma de Buenos Aires.

## 12 Contacto

Consultas sobre estos Términos: [support@bredaz.com](mailto:support@bredaz.com?subject=T%C3%A9rminos%20y%20Condiciones).

# Privacy Policy — EncryptIA by Bredaz

URL: https://bredaz.com/encryptia/privacy.html

1 Privacy Policy

This privacy policy applies to the EncryptIA app for mobile devices, together with any related services operated by Bredaz (collectively, the "Application"). Bredaz is hereby referred to as the "Service Provider".

## 2 Information Collection and Use

The Application collects information when you download and use it. This information may include information such as:

  * Your device's Internet Protocol address
  * The pages of the Application that you visit, the time and date of your visit, the time spent on those pages
  * The time spent on the Application
  * Your mobile operating system you use

The Service Provider may use the information you provide to send important information, required notices, and, where permitted by law, marketing communications.

For a better experience while using the Application, the Service Provider may require you to provide certain personally identifiable information, including but not limited to. The Application collects certain information when you download and use it. This information is primarily used to provide, maintain, and enhance the features of EncryptIA.

**User-Provided Data (Local Storage):**  
To personalize your experience, the Application requires you to enter a name or alias during the initial onboarding. This name, along with your learning progress, application preferences, and any cryptographic keys or messages saved in the Vault, is stored exclusively and locally on your device's internal storage. Bredaz does not transmit, collect, synchronize, or store this personal data on any external servers. If you uninstall the Application or clear its data, this information will be permanently deleted from your device.

**Device Permissions (Camera, Gallery, and Voice):**  
To provide advanced features, the Application may request explicit permission to access your device's camera, photo gallery, and microphone. These permissions are used strictly to enable core functionalities, such as scanning and identifying codes. All multimedia data (images and audio) is processed locally on your device. Bredaz does not upload, store, or share your camera feeds, photos, or voice recordings with any external servers or third parties.

**Artificial Intelligence (AI) Processing:**  
The Application utilizes Artificial Intelligence technologies, specifically local machine learning models, to analyze and identify scout codes and ciphers. We want to be absolutely clear: all AI processing is performed 100% offline within your device. No images, voice data, or personal information are sent to the cloud for AI analysis.

**Purchases and Subscriptions:**  
The Application offers in-app purchases and subscriptions (e.g., SCOUTER and PRO plans) to unlock premium features. All payment processing and transaction management are securely handled by Google Play Billing. Bredaz does not collect, process, or have access to your credit card information or sensitive financial data.

**Automatically Collected Data and Third-Party Services:**  
The Application may collect certain information automatically, including, but not limited to, the type of mobile device you use, your mobile operating system, and anonymous usage telemetry to improve the Application. Additionally, the Application uses third-party services, such as Google AdMob, to provide rewarded advertisements. These third-party providers may collect device identifiers and IP addresses to serve personalized or non-personalized ads, and they operate under their own independent privacy policies. The information the Service Provider requests will be retained and used as described in this privacy policy.

## 3 Cookies and Tracking Technologies

The Application or its third-party SDKs may use cookies, SDKs, pixels, and similar technologies to support functionality, analytics, or service delivery. Where required by applicable law, the Service Provider will obtain consent before using non-essential tracking technologies.

## 4 Your Rights

You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data held by the Service Provider. To exercise these rights, or to withdraw consent where processing is based on consent, contact the Service Provider at [support@bredaz.com](mailto:support@bredaz.com).

## 5 Your California Privacy Rights (CCPA/CPRA)

If you are a California resident, you have the right to know what personal information is collected, the right to delete personal information, the right to opt out of the sale or sharing of personal information, and the right to non-discrimination for exercising these rights. To exercise your CCPA/CPRA rights, contact the Service Provider at [support@bredaz.com](mailto:support@bredaz.com).

## 6 Artificial Intelligence

The Application uses Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies to enhance user experience and provide certain features. The AI components may process user data to deliver personalized content, recommendations, or automated functionalities. All AI processing is performed in accordance with this privacy policy and applicable laws. If you have questions about the AI features or data processing, please contact the Service Provider.

## 7 Third Party Access

Only aggregated, anonymized data is periodically transmitted to external services to aid the Service Provider in improving the Application and their service. The Service Provider may share your information with third parties in the ways that are described in this privacy statement.

Please note that the Application utilizes third-party services that have their own Privacy Policy about handling data. Below are the links to the Privacy Policy of the third-party service providers used by the Application:

  * [Google Play Services](https://www.google.com/policies/privacy/)
  * [AdMob](https://policies.google.com/technologies/partner-sites)

The Service Provider may disclose User Provided and Automatically Collected Information:

  * as required by law, such as to comply with a subpoena, or similar legal process;
  * when they believe in good faith that disclosure is necessary to protect their rights, protect your safety or the safety of others, investigate fraud, or respond to a government request;
  * with their trusted services providers who work on their behalf, do not have an independent use of the information the Service Provider discloses to them, and have agreed to adhere to the rules set forth in this privacy statement.

## 8 International Data Transfers

The Service Provider or its third-party service providers may transfer personal data to countries outside your country of residence, including outside the European Economic Area (EEA). Where applicable law requires safeguards for international transfers, the Service Provider will use appropriate mechanisms.

  * Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) approved by the European Commission
  * Adequacy decisions or other legally recognized transfer mechanisms
  * Your consent, where required and legally permitted

Data protection laws in other countries may differ from those in your jurisdiction. Where required by law, the Service Provider will apply appropriate safeguards and obtain any consent required for the transfer.

## 9 Opt-Out Rights

You can stop further collection of information from your mobile device by uninstalling the Application. Uninstalling will stop the Application from collecting data from your device, but it does not automatically delete information that has already been transmitted to the Service Provider or to third parties.

To request deletion of your personal data, to withdraw consent, or to exercise any of your rights, contact the Service Provider at [support@bredaz.com](mailto:support@bredaz.com).

## 10 Data Retention Policy

The Service Provider retains personal data based on its necessity for the stated purposes:

  * **User Provided Data:** Retained for the duration of your use of the Application plus 12 months thereafter, unless longer retention is required by law
  * **Automatically Collected Data:** Retained for up to 24 months from collection, unless longer retention is required for legal compliance
  * **Aggregated and Anonymized Data:** Retained indefinitely as it no longer identifies you
  * **Data required for legal compliance:** Retained as long as required by applicable law

You may request deletion of your personal data, subject to any legal obligation to retain it. If you want the Service Provider to delete User Provided Data submitted through the Application, please contact them at [support@bredaz.com](mailto:support@bredaz.com). Please note that some User Provided Data may be required for the Application to function properly.

## 11 Children

The Application is not intended for children under 16 years of age, or such higher age as required by applicable law. The Service Provider does not knowingly solicit data from children or market the Application to them.

Where parental or guardian consent is required under applicable law, the Application is not intended for use without that consent. The Service Provider does not knowingly collect personally identifiable information from children under 16 years of age in violation of applicable law. In the event the Service Provider discovers that a child has provided personal information, the Service Provider will immediately delete this from their servers. If you are a parent or guardian and you are aware that your child has provided the Service Provider with personal information, please contact the Service Provider ([support@bredaz.com](mailto:support@bredaz.com)) so that they will be able to take the necessary actions.

## 12 Security

The Service Provider is concerned about safeguarding the confidentiality of your information. The Service Provider provides physical, electronic, and procedural safeguards to protect information the Service Provider processes and maintains.

## 13 Data Breach Notification
